# `lint` command

Report bug-prone, obsolescent and non-portable Fortran constructs and parallel-code defects (OpenMP,
OpenACC, MPI).

```bash
fobis lint [PATHS...] [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Code quality](/cookbook/analysis).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

Arguments: `PATHS...`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Select a mode defined into a fobos file |
| `--src`, `-s` | TEXT |  | Root-directory of source files [default: ./] |
| `--select` | TEXT |  | Rule ids or prefixes to run (repeatable, comma-separated; 'ALL' for every rule). Replaces the default set. |
| `--ignore` | TEXT |  | Rule ids or prefixes to skip (repeatable, comma-separated). |
| `--format` | TEXT | `text` | Output format: text, json, sarif or github. |
| `--baseline` | TEXT |  | Baseline file: findings recorded there are not reported. |
| `--update-baseline` |  |  | Record all current findings into the baseline file and exit. |
| `--compiler-feedback` | TEXT |  | Build log with compiler optimisation reports (nvfortran -Minfo, gfortran -fopt-info); '-' reads stdin. |
| `--diff` |  |  | Print the automatic fixes as a unified diff; change nothing. |
| `--fix` |  |  | Apply the automatic fixes to the files, then report what remains. |
| `--exit-zero` |  |  | Exit 0 even when findings are reported. |
| `--list-rules` |  |  | List every rule and exit. |
| `--explain` | TEXT |  | Explain a rule (by id) and exit. |
| `--deep` |  |  | Review the findings with the LLM, region by region: a cited verdict per finding (confirmed, dismissed, uncertain) and advisory concerns. Nothing is hidden; the exit status is unchanged. |
| `--deep-max` | INTEGER | `10` | Review at most this many regions (most severe first). |
| `--deep-context` |  |  | With --deep or --ask: print what the model would receive, run no model. |
| `--ask` | TEXT |  | Ask a question about the code around FILE:LINE (given as the path), answered with citations. |
| `--varset` | TEXT |  | Apply one or more [varset:NAME] sections' $variable bindings before linting. |

<!-- cli:end -->
